pages.title: Riemann Zeta Crystal
pages.text: The zeta function encodes the distribution of primes in its zeros. Riemann conjectured that every non-trivial zero has real part exactly one half; nobody has proved it. This crystal grew in a single perfectly straight line, and every zero I have checked sits on it. It is cold and perfectly balanced.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Analytically continuing the sum over primes past where it converges took a modular form, the complex plane and superfluid helium to damp the noise. The crystal that formed grew along the critical line. I keep looking for a zero off it.
